decision: The universal shadow nomination materially improves the leader-removal minimum but suppresses too many valuable ordinary replacements in union and common-five. It is rejected and must not be tuned by confirmation days or score margins.
next_root_cause: The current leader grants liquidation authority when a challenger merely exceeds the weakest incumbent admission reference. Formal lower-tail evidence and the shadow counterfactual together support testing a portfolio-level campaign hurdle rather than a time confirmation: a challenger must exceed the strongest currently funded campaign admission reference before it may immediately displace the weakest incumbent.
evidence_readback: Hosted workflow completed tests, measurement, artifact upload, research/evidence append and remote SHA read-back successfully.
